name: create_playbook
title: Create playbook
description: Creates a playbook for one business responsibility, and returns it empty. Use it when the person wants something done that should keep working after this conversation, and none of their playbooks covers it. Each job it does again and again is a workflow, and each part of a job a function of the type that part needs. An id that is taken or retired is refused. `playbook` is the id every tool inside it takes, and `description` what it is for, in the person's words.

name: list_playbooks
title: List playbooks
description: Use it when the person speaks of their playbooks, or wants something done that one of them may cover. Lists the playbooks of the org that the caller may access, sorted by id. Each holds every field of the playbook, such as its name, what it is for and whether it is active.

include_retired.description: Whether to list retired playbooks as well; false when left out

name: retire_playbook
title: Retire playbook
description: Retires a playbook and returns it: it stays readable with its history, takes no changes or runs, and keeps its id, so no other playbook takes it. restore_playbook brings it back. Use retire_playbook when the person asks to retire that playbook; update_playbook changes its name or description. Retiring a retired playbook changes nothing.

name: restore_playbook
title: Restore playbook
description: Restores a retired playbook and returns it, active again under its own id, with its functions, workflows, page and history as they were when it was retired.
